description: Adventure Subaru is proud to offer this 2026 Subaru Forester Premium finished in Crimson Red Pearl. The Forester Premium is a well-rounded SUV that delivers comfort, efficiency, and all-weather confidence, making it an excellent choice for daily driving and weekend adventures alike.  This vehicle is a CARFAX One Owner with no accidents reported and has a good service history, reflecting consistent care and dependable ownership.  Under the hood, the Forester Premium is powered by a 2.5-liter DOHC SUBARU BOXER engine paired with a Lineartronic CVT and SI-Drive performance management. Subaru's Symmetrical All-Wheel Drive system and X-MODE traction control provide excellent stability and control in a variety of road and weather conditions. It also delivers strong fuel efficiency with EPA estimates of 26 MPG in the city and 33 MPG on the highway.  Safety is a key highlight, featuring Subaru's EyeSight Driver Assist Technology along with Advanced Adaptive Cruise Control with Lane Centering. Additional safety features include Vehicle Dynamics Control, Anti-Lock Braking System, Brake Assist, a rear vision camera with dynamic guidelines, and a full suite of airbags designed to enhance occupant protection.  Inside, the Forester Premium offers a spacious and comfortable cabin with dual-zone automatic climate control, a 10-way power drivers seat with lumbar support, and heated front seats as part of the All-Weather Package. The interior also features a leather-wrapped steering wheel, rear seat air vents, and a wireless smartphone charger for added convenience.  Technology is centered around the Subaru 11.6-inch Multimedia Plus system, featuring wireless Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, Bluetooth connectivity, SiriusXM capability, and multiple USB-A and USB-C ports throughout the vehicle.  Additional features include keyless access with push-button start, a panoramic power moonroof, roof rails with high load capacity, LED steering responsive headlights with high beam assist, LED fog lights, and 17-inch dark metallic alloy wheels.  This Forester also includes useful accessories such as an auto-dimming mirror with HomeLink, all-weather floor liners, cargo tray, and rear bumper cover to help protect and enhance the vehicle.  With an original MSRP of $35,832, this 2026 Forester Premium offers excellent value with a strong combination of safety, technology, and versatility.
